scenes.title: First look

scenes.study: The near-accident: hunt with the eyes before you speak; let your look lead the cut.

scenes.title: Scolded
scenes.act: The rich boy meets the widow
scenes.study: A son in front of his father: boredom and defiance, not guilt.

scenes.title: The pursuit
scenes.act: The rich boy meets the widow
scenes.study: Follow her through the city: playful, patient, never letting her out of sight.

scenes.title: The night take
scenes.act: The rich boy meets the widow
scenes.study: Restless at night with your friends: pacing, turning, appealing. Hold it without cuts.

scenes.title: Holi
scenes.act: The rich boy meets the widow
scenes.study: Obsession made physical: the voice drops and repeats.

scenes.title: Her name in his arm
scenes.act: The rich boy meets the widow
scenes.study: Carving her name: stillness, pain held behind the eyes, no words.

scenes.title: The hills song · part 1
scenes.study: Love in the mountains: the open arms, the turns, the chase and the catch.

scenes.title: The hills song · part 2
scenes.study: Love in the mountains: the open arms, the turns, the chase and the catch.

scenes.title: The hills song · part 3
scenes.study: Love in the mountains: the open arms, the turns, the chase and the catch.

scenes.title: At the temple
scenes.study: Persistence without pressure: speak to her again, gently.

scenes.title: The boardroom
scenes.study: Walk into your father's meeting and take the room. Stillness while others react.

scenes.title: Public defiance
scenes.study: Expose your father in front of his guests: the voice rises, the body stays planted.

scenes.title: Folded hands
scenes.study: The swagger gone: beg for the girl you love, and ask "is it her fault she is a widow?"

scenes.title: The yes
scenes.study: The family says yes: let the joy arrive slowly, then all at once.

scenes.title: The wedding
scenes.study: A small wedding, his friends around him: a groom who cannot stop smiling.

scenes.title: Back with the gang
scenes.study: Back on the street with your friends: easy, teasing, a man at home in his crowd.

scenes.title: My lottery is you, Maa
scenes.study: Bringing gifts home: the son-in-law as a son.

scenes.title: By the sea with Maa
scenes.study: A quiet talk with your mother-in-law: warmth and respect.

scenes.title: The rush home
scenes.study: Racing home through traffic: urgency in the hands and eyes, all inside a jeep.

scenes.title: Karva Chauth
scenes.study: Late home, scolded, and charming your way out of it.

scenes.title: Rescue in the rain
scenes.study: Save a stranger from a beating, without knowing who he is.

scenes.title: At the bedside
scenes.study: The doctor's news: concern for a man you barely know.

scenes.title: Moonset
scenes.study: Coming home at dawn: tell your wife about the stranger you saved.

scenes.title: The stranger wakes
scenes.study: The broken man wakes: listen more than you speak.

scenes.title: Birthday morning
scenes.study: Playful and grand: promise a celebration.

scenes.title: The stranger
scenes.study: In the hospital: befriend a broken man and insist he come home.

scenes.title: The party
scenes.study: The happy host: the only one in the room who does not know.

scenes.title: The realisation
scenes.study: Ravi sings and everything changes: play the moment the truth reaches you, without a word.

scenes.title: The truth
scenes.study: Outside the room while the truth comes out: hold it all in the face.

scenes.title: The rooftop
scenes.study: The villain over the edge: rage and control at once.

scenes.title: Ravi's sacrifice
scenes.study: His friend smiles one last time: shock, then grief, in seconds.
